where: Section 1, paragraph starting 'Each privileged mode has its own R13 (SP)...'
problem: It says every privileged mode has its own SPSR. That is false for System mode. System is privileged but shares the User register bank (R13_usr, R14_usr) and has no SPSR of its own, so the rule as written contradicts standard ARM documentation and also contradicts the chapter's own next sentence about System mode.
fix: Each privileged mode has its own R13 (SP) and R14 (LR), and its own SPSR — except System mode, which is privileged but shares the User mode bank and has no SPSR. User mode has no SPSR either.

where: Section 2 and Exam traps, return rules
problem: The return rules list IRQ/FIQ (#4), data abort (#8) and SWI (MOVS PC, LR), but never give prefetch abort. A student can read the trap 'IRQ and FIQ return subtract 4 bytes' and conclude that only those two exceptions use #4, so the prefetch abort case is left untested and unclear.
fix: Add: prefetch abort saves LR_pab pointing 4 bytes past the faulting instruction, so it returns with SUBS PC, LR, #4, the same as IRQ and FIQ. Data abort alone uses #8.
